features.name: Baseline Concurrent User Capacity
features.description: Support at least 1,000 concurrent users performing typical operations without performance degradation

requirementDetails.userStory: As the car rental business grows, I want the platform to scale seamlessly to support more users, vehicles, locations, and transactions, so that growth is never constrained by technical limitations.
acceptanceCriteria: System maintains all performance requirements with 1,000 concurrent users
Response times remain within specified limits
No user experiences errors due to capacity constraints
Database connections scale appropriately
Application servers handle load without crashes

features.name: Horizontal Scaling to 10,000 Concurrent Users
features.description: Architect system to scale horizontally to support 10,000 concurrent users through infrastructure expansion

requirementDetails.userStory: As a platform operator, I want horizontal scaling capability to support large-scale growth.
acceptanceCriteria: Application tier scales horizontally by adding servers
Load balancer distributes traffic across multiple servers
Database supports read replicas for query scaling
Caching layer scales to handle increased load
No architectural changes required to reach 10,000 concurrent users

features.name: Auto-Scaling for Peak Load
features.description: Automatically scale resources to maintain acceptable performance during traffic spikes up to 5x normal load

requirementDetails.userStory: As a platform operator, I want auto-scaling to handle traffic spikes without manual intervention.
acceptanceCriteria: Auto-scaling triggers when CPU utilization exceeds 70%
New application instances launch within 2 minutes
Load balancer automatically includes new instances
System scales down when load decreases to avoid waste
Scaling events are logged and monitored

features.name: Serverless Function Auto-Scaling
features.description: Scale serverless functions automatically from 0 to 1,000+ concurrent executions without pre-provisioned capacity

requirementDetails.userStory: As a platform operator, I want serverless scaling for variable workloads without over-provisioning.
acceptanceCriteria: Serverless functions scale from 0 to 1,000+ concurrent executions
No manual capacity planning required for serverless components
Pricing calculations scale independently of core application
Search operations scale independently during high-demand periods
Cost scales linearly with actual usage

features.name: Vehicle Inventory Growth Support
features.description: Support growth from initial fleet size to at least 10,000 vehicles without architectural changes

requirementDetails.userStory: As a fleet operator, I want the system to handle large vehicle inventories efficiently.
acceptanceCriteria: Database schema supports millions of vehicle records
Search performance remains acceptable with 10,000+ vehicles
Availability calculations complete efficiently at scale
Vehicle images and media scale with fleet growth
Admin interfaces remain responsive with large fleets

features.name: Booking History Scalability
features.description: Efficiently manage booking history growth to millions of records over multiple years

requirementDetails.userStory: As a platform operator, I want efficient booking history management for compliance and analytics.
acceptanceCriteria: Database supports at least 10 million booking records
User booking history queries remain fast (< 1 second)
Admin reporting queries complete within acceptable timeframes
Data archival strategies exist for old bookings
Historical data is accessible for analytics and compliance

features.name: User Account Growth to 100,000
features.description: Support growth to at least 100,000 user accounts without performance degradation

requirementDetails.userStory: As a platform operator, I want the system to handle large numbers of user accounts efficiently.
acceptanceCriteria: User authentication remains fast with large user base
User search and management tools remain responsive
Email and notification systems scale with user growth
User data storage scales appropriately
Privacy and security controls scale with user base

features.name: Media and File Storage Scalability
features.description: Scale storage for vehicle images, documents, and user-generated content to at least 10TB

requirementDetails.userStory: As a platform operator, I want scalable storage for media files without capacity constraints.
acceptanceCriteria: Object storage (S3 or equivalent) handles large file volumes
CDN delivers images efficiently regardless of volume
Image optimization reduces storage requirements
Backup and disaster recovery scale with storage growth
Storage costs remain predictable and manageable

features.name: Multi-Location Support
features.description: Support expansion from single location to at least 50 locations without architectural limitations

requirementDetails.userStory: As a business operator, I want to expand to multiple locations without system limitations.
acceptanceCriteria: Location hierarchy supports multiple levels (region → city → branch)
Fleet management scales across multiple locations
Pricing varies by location without performance impact
Reporting aggregates data across all locations
Inter-location transfers are supported and tracked

features.name: Multi-Region Deployment
features.description: Support deployment across multiple cloud regions for performance and reliability

requirementDetails.userStory: As a global platform operator, I want multi-region deployment for optimal performance worldwide.
acceptanceCriteria: Application deploys to multiple cloud regions
Database replication supports multi-region deployments
Users are routed to nearest region for optimal performance
Data residency requirements are met for each region
Failover between regions occurs automatically

features.name: Multi-Tenant Architecture
features.description: Efficiently isolate and scale tenant data for multiple rental companies in SaaS model

requirementDetails.userStory: As a SaaS provider, I want multi-tenant architecture to serve multiple rental companies efficiently.
acceptanceCriteria: Each tenant's data is logically or physically isolated
Tenant-specific configurations are supported
Shared infrastructure serves multiple tenants efficiently
Tenant onboarding is streamlined and scalable
Tenant-specific analytics and reporting are available

features.name: Independent Microservice Scaling
features.description: Enable independent scaling of each microservice based on its specific load patterns

requirementDetails.userStory: As a platform operator with microservices, I want fine-grained scaling per service.
acceptanceCriteria: Inventory service scales independently based on search load
Pricing service scales independently based on calculation demand
Booking service scales independently based on transaction volume
Identity service scales independently based on authentication load
Each service has independent resource allocation and scaling policies

features.name: Service Mesh Scalability
features.description: Handle inter-service communication at scale without service mesh becoming a bottleneck

requirementDetails.userStory: As a platform operator with service mesh, I want it to handle high request volumes efficiently.
acceptanceCriteria: Service mesh handles at least 10,000 requests per second
Service discovery scales with number of service instances
Load balancing distributes traffic efficiently across instances
Circuit breakers prevent cascading failures at scale
Observability tools track performance across all services

features.name: Message Queue Scalability
features.description: Scale message processing to handle high volumes with consumer auto-scaling

requirementDetails.userStory: As a platform operator, I want message queues to handle high volumes for asynchronous processing.
acceptanceCriteria: Message queues handle at least 1,000 messages per second
Consumer services scale based on queue depth
Dead letter queues capture failed messages for retry
Message processing latency remains acceptable under load
Queue monitoring alerts on backlog growth

features.name: Database Read Scaling
features.description: Scale database read operations through replication and caching strategies

requirementDetails.userStory: As a platform operator, I want read scaling to handle high query volumes.
acceptanceCriteria: Read replicas distribute query load across multiple database instances
Application routes read queries to replicas
Write queries go to primary database instance
Replication lag remains under 1 second
Caching layer reduces database query load by at least 50%

features.name: Database Write Scaling with Sharding
features.description: Implement sharding or partitioning strategies when write operations exceed single database capacity

requirementDetails.userStory: As a platform operator at very large scale, I want write scaling through sharding.
acceptanceCriteria: Database sharding strategy is defined and documented
Sharding key distributes data evenly across shards
Application layer routes queries to appropriate shards
Cross-shard queries are minimized through design
Shard rebalancing is possible as data grows

features.name: Database per Service Pattern
features.description: Manage data consistency across services with database per service pattern in microservices

requirementDetails.userStory: As a platform operator with microservices, I want database per service for independent scaling.
acceptanceCriteria: Each microservice owns its data exclusively
Services communicate through APIs, not direct database access
Saga pattern manages distributed transactions
Event sourcing captures state changes for consistency
Eventual consistency is acceptable for non-critical operations

features.name: API Gateway Scaling
features.description: Implement API gateway that scales to handle all external and internal API traffic

requirementDetails.userStory: As a platform operator, I want API gateway to scale without becoming a bottleneck.
acceptanceCriteria: API gateway handles at least 5,000 requests per second
Rate limiting prevents abuse without impacting legitimate users
API gateway scales horizontally as traffic grows
Authentication and authorization scale with API traffic
API analytics track usage patterns and performance

features.name: Third-Party Integration Scaling Management
features.description: Manage third-party integrations to scale with platform growth while respecting rate limits

requirementDetails.userStory: As a platform operator, I want third-party integrations to scale predictably.
acceptanceCriteria: Integration rate limits are monitored and respected
Retry logic handles temporary integration failures
Circuit breakers prevent cascading failures from integration issues
Integration costs scale predictably with usage
Alternative providers can be added for redundancy

features.name: Metrics Collection at Scale
features.description: Collect and store performance metrics, logs, and traces at scale without impacting application performance

requirementDetails.userStory: As a platform operator, I want observability that scales without becoming a burden.
acceptanceCriteria: Metrics collection overhead is less than 5% of CPU
Log aggregation handles at least 10,000 log entries per second
Distributed tracing samples appropriately at high volumes
Metrics retention policies balance cost and utility
Monitoring systems scale with application growth

features.name: Resource Optimization for Cost-Effective Scaling
features.description: Optimize resource utilization to minimize costs while meeting performance and scalability requirements

requirementDetails.userStory: As a platform operator, I want cost-effective scaling that balances performance and cost.
acceptanceCriteria: Auto-scaling policies balance performance and cost
Resources scale down during low-demand periods
Reserved instances or savings plans reduce compute costs
Storage tiering moves infrequently accessed data to cheaper storage
Cost monitoring alerts on unexpected spending increases

features.name: Capacity Planning Process
features.description: Implement capacity planning processes to anticipate and prepare for growth

requirementDetails.userStory: As a platform operator, I want capacity planning to prevent performance issues and enable cost-effective procurement.
acceptanceCriteria: Usage trends are analyzed monthly
Capacity forecasts project 6 months ahead
Infrastructure changes are planned before capacity constraints
Load testing validates capacity before major events
Capacity planning documentation is maintained

features.name: Load Testing for Scalability Validation
features.description: Conduct load testing to verify scalability and identify bottlenecks before production

requirementDetails.userStory: As a platform operator, I want load testing to validate scalability before issues occur.
acceptanceCriteria: Load tests simulate expected concurrent user loads
Load tests verify auto-scaling behavior
Load tests identify bottlenecks before production
Load test results are documented and reviewed
Load testing is automated in CI/CD pipeline

features.name: Chaos Engineering for Resilience Validation
features.description: Implement chaos engineering practices to validate resilience and scaling behavior under adverse conditions

requirementDetails.userStory: As a platform operator, I want chaos engineering to validate resilience mechanisms work correctly.
acceptanceCriteria: Chaos experiments simulate service failures
Chaos experiments validate auto-scaling behavior
Chaos experiments test circuit breaker effectiveness
Chaos experiments run regularly in non-production environments
Chaos experiment results drive improvements
